If you are new to all this, no problem, we are glad to help you with tooling and further explanation, to get you started attacking the testnet! Worth adding ENR info or multiaddrs for the participating nodes? There's bootnode info to get started. We could add all nodes, or maybe just expect users to peer after running dv5 anyway. What do you think <@!291925846556540928> ? Should be fun 🙂 bootnodes added to readme https://notes.ethereum.org/@protolambda/rumor-tutorial How to use rumor, for anyone who likes to use it for messing with the attack-net <@!144468805697929216> Thanks for the quick PR, if you find anything else, lmk. Hope the above doc helps you 🙂 having some trouble with the `lighthouse-attack-0` bootnodes. network is still up and stable but discovery seems to be interrupted. I won't be able to debug until later today are the validating nodes statically peered? nope, discovery cool thanks net was put up yesterday so something could have gotten messed up with dv5 between then and now but not sure atm fyi, i can join and participate in gossip using the lighthouse enrs i already know about...i just cant find new ones thanks, good to know I wonder if it improves once it cross pollinates with other testnets. Small tables can be problematic > I wonder if it improves once it cross pollinates with other testnets. Small tables can be problematic <@!203220829473996800> idk, i found all the validating nodes on the prysm attacknet in one query > net was put up yesterday so something could have gotten messed up with dv5 between then and now Who gets the reward when the network breaks itself? > Who gets the reward when the network breaks itself? <@!573787335796326400> It is burned, obviously. 🤣 I said client teams cant get the reward for nets that their client is participating in but I didnt disqualify myself... Looks like <@!604062686623432740> managed to crash discovery in lighthouse (without crashing the beacon node process/finality on the network) Jonny will be getting an honorable mention for `lighthouse-attack-0` :) Age is working on a fix. I'll ping here when discovery is back up for that net
